title: Weekly review — Nov 2
body:

title: Ideas for Mom's 70th
body:
She keeps mentioning the lake house from when we were kids — maybe rent a cabin at Lake Tahoe for a long weekend in June and invite the cousins.

Gift ideas: a framed print of the old family photo (Aunt Rosa has the original), a pottery class together, or the Le Creuset dutch oven in 'Sea Salt' she pointed at last Christmas.

Budget split with Marco: roughly $400 each.

title: Podcast notes: deep work and attention
body:
Key idea: attention residue — switching tasks leaves part of your attention on the previous task, so context switching costs more than it feels like.

Tactics mentioned: time-block the calendar the night before, batch shallow work (email, Slack) into two windows a day, and keep a 'shutdown ritual' at the end of the workday.

Try: no Slack before 10am for two weeks and see if the morning writing block gets better.

title: Home network password rotation reminder
body: Rotate the guest Wi-Fi password every quarter. Last rotated: August. The admin credentials live in the password manager under 'Router — Eero', never in notes.
